description: This file declares utility functions, classes, and methods for testing and analyzing PyTorch JIT models and IR, specifically related to static runtime compatibility and comparison.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a node in the computation graph, used for inspection and analysis.

classes.name: StaticModule
classes.description: Represents a static JIT module, used for runtime analysis and processing.

methods.name: testStaticRuntime
methods.description: Runs a static runtime test by executing a model or IR script with specified arguments and comparing results.

methods.name: getGraphFromScript
methods.description: Parses a JIT script into a computation graph.

methods.name: getGraphFromIR
methods.description: Converts IR string into a computation graph for further analysis.

methods.name: hasProcessedNodeWithName
methods.description: Checks if the static module has a processed node with the specified name.

methods.name: getTensor
methods.description: Extracts an at::Tensor from an IValue.

methods.name: getNodeWithKind
methods.description: Retrieves a node from a graph or static module with a specific kind.

methods.name: hasNodeWithKind
methods.description: Checks if a graph or static module contains a node of a specific kind.

methods.name: compareResultsWithJIT
methods.description: Compares the results of static runtime with JIT for consistency.

methods.name: compareResults
methods.description: Compares two IValues to check if they are approximately equal, with options for tolerance.
